subject: bus
source: Cambridge IGCSE Business Studies (0450) syllabus (2023–2026 exams) and its successor Cambridge IGCSE Business (0264) for examination in 2027, 2028 and 2029 (content largely unchanged) — Cambridge International; Year 11 covers sections 4–6 and full-course revision

weeks.topic: Production of goods and services: job, batch and flow production
objectives: Explain how production adds value
Compare job, batch and flow production

weeks.topic: Productivity, lean production and inventory management
objectives: Explain ways to improve productivity
Describe lean production including JIT and kaizen
Interpret inventory control charts

weeks.topic: Technology and automation in production
objectives: Explain the benefits and drawbacks of automation
Describe the use of technology such as CAD and CAM

weeks.topic: Costs: fixed, variable, total and average
objectives: Classify fixed and variable costs
Calculate total and average costs

weeks.topic: Economies and diseconomies of scale
objectives: Explain types of economies of scale
Explain diseconomies of scale

weeks.topic: Break-even analysis: charts, calculations and margin of safety
objectives: Draw and interpret break-even charts
Calculate break-even output and margin of safety
Evaluate the usefulness of break-even analysis

weeks.topic: Achieving quality: quality control, quality assurance and TQM
objectives: Explain the importance of quality
Compare quality control, quality assurance and TQM

weeks.topic: Location decisions: manufacturing, retail and international
objectives: Explain factors affecting location of manufacturing and service businesses
Explain factors affecting choice of country

weeks.topic: Business finance: why businesses need finance
objectives: Explain start-up, expansion and working capital needs
Distinguish short-term and long-term needs

weeks.topic: Sources of finance: internal and external, short and long term
objectives: Compare internal and external sources of finance
Explain factors affecting the choice of finance

weeks.topic: Cash-flow forecasting
objectives: Construct and interpret a cash-flow forecast
Explain why cash is important

weeks.topic: Working capital and improving cash flow
objectives: Explain the importance of working capital
Suggest ways to improve cash flow

weeks.topic: Income statements
objectives: Explain revenue, cost of sales, gross profit and profit
Interpret simple income statements

weeks.topic: Statement of financial position
objectives: Explain assets and liabilities
Interpret a simple statement of financial position

weeks.topic: Review: operations management and finance
objectives: Practise break-even, cash-flow and accounting calculations
Revise production and quality concepts

weeks.topic: Analysis of accounts: profitability ratios
objectives: Calculate gross profit margin, profit margin and ROCE
Interpret profitability ratios

weeks.topic: Liquidity ratios and users of accounts
objectives: Calculate current ratio and acid test ratio
Explain how different users use accounts

weeks.topic: Economic issues: the business cycle and government economic objectives
objectives: Describe the stages of the business cycle
Explain government objectives such as low inflation, low unemployment and economic growth

weeks.topic: Government economic policies: fiscal, monetary and supply-side
objectives: Explain how taxes, government spending and interest rates affect businesses
Explain supply-side policies

weeks.topic: Environmental concerns: externalities and sustainable development
objectives: Explain external costs and benefits
Explain how governments and pressure groups influence business decisions

weeks.topic: Ethical issues: child labour, fair trade and social responsibility
objectives: Explain ethical decisions businesses face
Evaluate the costs and benefits of acting ethically

weeks.topic: Globalisation: opportunities and threats; protectionism
objectives: Explain the opportunities and threats of globalisation
Describe tariffs, quotas and protectionism

weeks.topic: Multinational companies
objectives: Explain the benefits and drawbacks of multinationals for host countries
Explain why businesses become multinationals

weeks.topic: Exchange rates: appreciation and depreciation
objectives: Explain how exchange rates are determined
Calculate the effects of exchange rate changes on importers and exporters

weeks.topic: Case study skills: analysis and evaluation for Paper 2
objectives: Use case study evidence in answers
Make justified recommendations

weeks.topic: Business calculations: formulas and ratios practice
objectives: Practise all formulas in the syllabus
Interpret results in business context

weeks.topic: Mock exams: Paper 1 short answer and data response, Paper 2 case study
objectives: Complete full-length mock papers under exam conditions
Use feedback to build a revision plan

weeks.topic: Review: understanding business activity
objectives: Revise business types, growth and objectives
Practise definition and explain questions

weeks.topic: Review: people in business
objectives: Revise motivation, organisation and recruitment
Practise analysis questions

weeks.topic: Review: marketing
objectives: Revise market research and the marketing mix
Practise evaluation questions

weeks.topic: Review: operations management
objectives: Revise production methods, costs and location
Practise break-even questions

weeks.topic: Review: financial information and decisions
objectives: Revise finance sources, cash flow and accounts
Practise ratio calculations

weeks.topic: Review: external influences on business activity
objectives: Revise economic, environmental and international influences
Practise case-study evaluations

weeks.topic: IGCSE exams: Paper 1 short answer and data response
objectives: Answer all questions with accurate definitions and calculations
Apply answers to the business context

weeks.topic: IGCSE exams: Paper 2 case study
objectives: Analyse an unseen case study
Make justified decisions with evaluation

weeks.topic: IGCSE exams: between-paper revision of formulas and case-study technique
objectives: Rehearse key formulas and definitions between papers
Practise quick analysis and evaluation plans

weeks.topic: IGCSE exams: final exam window and course reflection
objectives: Complete any remaining exam papers
Consider next steps in IB Business Management or A Level Business
